description: Use this when the user asks what's new from their Winquill watches: new matching tenders, pipeline notices, deadline changes, clarifications, cancellations and awards. Without since, it gives the updates not shown before and marks them seen. Agents that check on a schedule pass since, the nextSince from the answer before: it reads what was recorded after it, oldest first, and marks nothing. watch_id keeps to one watch. Needs a Winquill account. Not for searching (use search_tenders). Example: {"since":"eyJzZXEiOjQyfQ"}

since.description: The nextSince from an earlier answer, for the updates recorded after it. Leave it out for the updates not yet shown, which are then marked seen.

watch_id.description: Only this watch's updates, by the id watch_tenders gave.

name: get_tender_updates

nextSince.description: Pass it back as since for the updates recorded after these. Reading with since marks nothing as seen, so it can be read again.

tender.description: The same facts as a search_tenders result.

title: Get tender alerts
